text.p: EVEREN Securities on Monday said it raised its estimate on Nationwide Health Properties Inc's 1998 funds from operation (FFO) to $2.03 a share from $2.01.
-- EVEREN left its 1997 FFO estimate on Nationwide unchanged at $1.89.
-- The firm offered an initial 1999 estimate of $2.15 a share.
-- Nationwide's second-quarter FFO rose to $0.47 a share, from $0.44 in the same period a year earlier, in line with EVEREN's estimate and the consensus forecast by analysts.
-- Nationwide is a real estate investment trust with stakes in about 240 health-care facilities in 30 states.

-- "The catalyst behind NHP's strong growth continues to be management's ability to identify and exploit value-added investment opportunities within long-term care, manage a very successful capital markets strategy and maintain expenses," EVEREN said.
-- Its shares were down 5/16 at 23-5/8 Monday afternoon.
